% A guard: it checks a case that the fix of the files that name themselves
% with \ProvidesFile must not break.
% A copy of TeX Live's dvipsnam.def in a subfolder, read with \input
% after xcolor. The copy names itself \ProvidesFile{dvipsnam.def}, so
% tex4ht reads dvipsnam.4ht, as for the tree's file. As in the PDF, a
% named color keeps its value. Replace the copy with the tree's file after
% an update of LaTeX.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{xcolor}
\makeatletter
\input{test-provname/vendor/dvipsnam.def}
\makeatother
\begin{document}
\textcolor[named]{BrickRed}{Brick red text.}
\end{document}
